This role requires designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable database systems to ensure high availability and performance. Key Responsibilities: • Design, deploy, and optimize database architectures to meet performance and scalability requirements. • Implement monitoring, alerting, and automated recovery processes for database systems. • Lead incident response and post-mortem analysis to minimize downtime and improve system resilience. • Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate database best practices into development workflows. • Evaluate and adopt new database technologies and tools to enhance reliability and efficiency. Required Skills & Qualifications: • 5+ years of experience in database administration or reliability engineering with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar systems. • Strong proficiency in SQL and database optimization techniques. • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and their managed database services. • Knowledge of infrastructure as code tools like Terraform or Ansible for database deployments. • Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog. • Ability to automate routine database tasks and write scripts in Python, Bash, or Go. • Understanding of database security best practices and compliance requirements. • Experience with high-availability configurations and disaster recovery planning. More About the Opportunity: This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development | Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the stability and scalability of mission-critical database systems. The position involves direct collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive improvements in database performance and reliability. Equal Opportunity Employer: We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications. Apply Now!
